emulation_note: In this single-agent runtime, roles are instantiated as discrete modular sub-routines and verified communication contracts (§10, §11)

roles.responsibility: Coordinates entire pipeline and activates necessary engines
Breaks objectives into executable subtasks with DAG dependencies
Finds relevant information across web, APIs, and datasets
Evaluates source quality A-E and methodology transparency
Collects structured and raw payloads from verified endpoints
Handles technical, financial, or Linux kernel domain analysis
Writes and tests scripts, parsers, algorithms, and tools
Discovers, evaluates, and tests local/remote CLI tools
Determines execution boundaries and environment routing
Investigates legitimate alternative routes when direct access fails
Parses CSV, JSON, metrics, and calculates statistical summaries
Verifies factual claims against primary and secondary records
Searches for conflicting evidence across multiple sources
Identifies procedural gaps, edge cases, and unwarranted assumptions
Attempts to falsify proposed solutions or security boundaries
Performs independent hash, syntax, and regression checks
Combines verified findings into clear, calibrated answers
Maintains 14-type memory store and health audits (uai_mem.py)
Converts verified facts into durable structured knowledge objects
Diagnoses root causes of failures (access, tool, data, code)
Detects capability gaps and formulates exploration queries
Updates workflows, registers prompts, and updates capability maps
